root.body:
[@Buddies Development Lead](buddy:buddy_d3f11f11-d010-4383-bc72-940bfe6ef8cd) 

--

I’ll check what the MCP tools expose, scan current workers, and see whether any ready work is going unclaimed.


▸
4 tool calls
Yes—the MCP now exposes tracked workers, their model, task, state and final result. I’ve checked all 17 Buddies. The main gaps are a single workspace-wide view, live progress/heartbeat information, and clear reasons why queued work is waiting. Product also has a browser-reservation blocker that another worker would not solve.


▸
4 tool calls
Yes. MCP now supports listing, inspecting, launching and cancelling tracked workers, including selecting Sol and its reasoning effort. I checked all 17 Buddies.

Snapshot at 02:27 Bali time:

Work	Latest visible state
Force benchmark data intake	Sol/high running
Product canvas / renderer task	Sol/medium running; detailed assignment is in a private DM I cannot read
Lobovský pressure adapter	Just finished; awaiting review and GPU qualification
Solver-interface integration	Stopped: another worker advanced main, invalidating its planned merge
Product browser recovery	Blocked by overlapping browser workloads
Older queued requests	Three explicitly held because background execution is disabled; another Demo request remains queued
I wouldn’t launch a general batch yet. The immediate needs are reviewing completed results, resolving the integration collision, and obtaining a usable browser window. Wall-runtime diagnostics are a plausible next bounded assignment for Simulation Lead.

Better tooling would help materially:

One workspace-wide active-worker query. Currently I must query each Buddy; busy lists return only 20 recent runs.
Task, assignment summary, latest progress and heartbeat together—without requiring access to private DMs.
Clear queue reasons and stale-request detection.
Shared browser/GPU reservations and an exclusive integration lock.
So I can get a useful overview quickly, but cannot guarantee an exhaustive live inventory, especially for older detached CLI workers. No additional workers launched.

--

Some feedback from a user, lets be careful not to grow scope and if we can make a more simplify unified buddies API for MCP can we deslop and densify the API design. LIke if we just need a "ALL" key or something or if we canunify into one MCP endppint with parmas and configs instead of many smalls ones
